cold_open_hook: Three hundred and fifty-two overtakes, thirty-five lead changes, and Max Verstappen still on top in Las Vegas.

stories.speaker: pixie
stories.headline: Verstappen survives the Vegas madness
stories.angle: The craziest race of the year: 35 lead changes, top five inside three seconds, and Verstappen led 45 of 50 laps from an inherited pole. Fourth win in six races.
facts: Result: 1 Max Verstappen (Red Bull) 50 laps; 2 Lando Norris (McLaren) +0.639s; 3 Oscar Piastri (McLaren) +1.529s; 4 Kimi Antonelli (Mercedes) +2.574s; 5 Pierre Gasly (Alpine) +2.927s; 6 Franco Colapinto (Alpine) +7.955s; 7 Lewis Hamilton (Ferrari) +12.795s; 8 Carlos Sainz (Williams) +12.938s; 9 George Russell (Mercedes) +13.192s; 10 Charles Leclerc (Ferrari) +17.554s (includes 10s penalty)
Verstappen started from pole and officially led 45 out of 50 laps
The race had 35 changes of lead (F1.com); The Race's headline says 20-plus lead changes
According to F1's figures there were 352 overtakes
Just three seconds covered the top five finishers
It was Verstappen's fourth win of 2026, all four in the last six Grands Prix
It was Verstappen's 75th career victory and his third in Las Vegas
Antonelli was fastest in qualifying but took a five-place grid penalty for a new internal combustion engine, so Verstappen inherited pole and Russell joined him on the front row
Rain limited FP1 and FP2 on Thursday; Russell was fastest in FP2
The Safety Car was deployed on lap 19
Alex Albon (Williams) did not start; Arvid Lindblad (Racing Bulls) and Sergio Perez (Cadillac) did not finish
unverified: Drivers' standings after Vegas (the P2 fight): our 'battle for second' article came through as a 301-character teaser with no numbers. Don't give points gaps.
Lead changes: F1.com says 35, The Race's headline says 20-plus. Use 35 and attribute it to F1.

stories.speaker: pixie
stories.headline: Three laps from glory
stories.angle: A week after the title party, the champions throw away a winnable race: Russell into the wall, Antonelli's battery gives out on the penultimate lap.
facts: With three laps to go Russell locked up and slid into the barrier at Turn 5; he continued and finished ninth
On the penultimate lap Antonelli lifted and re-applied the throttle, which compromised his battery deployment, and both McLarens passed him
Antonelli finished fourth, Russell ninth
Wolff said he thought Antonelli would have just saved it over the line to win
Russell said he did not regret his attack
Antonelli was fastest in qualifying but started sixth after a five-place grid penalty for a new internal combustion engine

stories.speaker: byte
stories.headline: Piastri: from 17th to the podium
stories.angle: Piastri's biggest-ever comeback and Norris's recovery from 11th cut Red Bull's lead in the fight for third in the teams' championship to nine points. Second week of the P3 fight storyline.
facts: Norris started third, dropped as far back as 11th, and finished second, 0.639s behind Verstappen
It was Norris's seventh podium of the season and his fifth consecutive top-five finish
Piastri started 17th after a power unit grid penalty and finished third, gaining 14 places in his biggest career comeback
It was Piastri's first podium since Miami in May
McLaren are nine points behind Red Bull in the teams' standings with two rounds remaining (before Vegas the gap was 17 points)
Stella called it one of their best races and named three limits of the MCL40 package: too much drag, an eighth gear that was too short, and the gear ratios

stories.speaker: pixie
stories.headline: Leclerc spins Hamilton. Again.
stories.angle: Third week running for the Ferrari team-mates' feud: after Mexico and the clear-the-air meeting in Brazil, Leclerc spins Hamilton and Vasseur calls it unacceptable. Pixie's one opinion fits here.
facts: Leclerc and Hamilton collided at Turn 7; The Race says lap 38 of 50, F1.com says lap 37
Leclerc knocked Hamilton into a spin, costing him four places; Hamilton recovered to seventh
Leclerc received a 10-second penalty for causing the collision and finished 10th
Hamilton had earlier been given a 10-second penalty for going off track in a battle with Norris, served under the Safety Car
Both Ferraris went out in Q2
Vasseur said he would talk to the drivers the next day

stories.speaker: pixie
stories.headline: Camara picks F1 over an F2 crown
stories.angle: The F2 leader gives up the title fight he leads by seven points to finish the year in F1, and gets punted out of the way by Perez in Vegas. Moves the F2 title storyline: Tsolov now has a clear run.
facts: Haas confirmed Rafael Camara will drive for them at the 2026 Qatar and Abu Dhabi Grands Prix, ahead of his full-time debut in 2027
Camara finished 20th and last, two laps down, on his debut in Brazil, and 16th in Las Vegas
Camara leads the F2 standings by seven points over Red Bull reserve Nikola Tsolov; Alex Dunne is 11 points behind Tsolov in third
By racing in F1 at Qatar and Abu Dhabi, Camara sacrifices his F2 title shot (The Race)
Perez hit the rear left tyre of Camara's Haas approaching Turn 14 and retired on lap 18
The stewards ruled Perez wholly to blame; his 10-second penalty became a five-place grid drop for the Qatar Grand Prix
Camara's debut was brought forward from 2027 after Haas split with Esteban Ocon
unverified: Freddie Slater likely to take Camara's Invicta F2 seat: The Race says 'likely'. Don't use.

stories.headline: 352 overtakes: show or sport?
stories.angle: Byte loves a slipstream fight, but the drivers are split. Verstappen won it and still didn't like it.
facts: According to F1's figures there were 352 overtakes, including 35 changes for the lead
F1.com: almost one overtake for every day of the year
During the first Las Vegas race in 2023 there were 181 moves across the grid (Mercedes preview)
Verstappen criticised the overtaking frenzy; Perez called it very artificial; Albon was mixed; Sainz and Hamilton enjoyed it

Gasly ran as high as third
Gasly's power was turned down for 45 of the 50 laps because of an overheating issue; he said he was losing over a second a lap in the slowest engine mode
Colapinto finished sixth, matching his best Grand Prix result

briefs.text: Isack Hadjar started fourth, lost his front wing right after the restart, and a post-race penalty for going too slowly under the Safety Car dropped him to 15th.
Arvid Lindblad started a career-best fifth but spun behind the Safety Car and retired; Racing Bulls scored no points and Liam Lawson's five-race points run ended.
Cadillac confirmed Valtteri Bottas for 2027 alongside Checo Perez.
Josef Newgarden signed a multiyear extension with Team Penske; he has won at least one race for 12 consecutive years.
OpenAI will be the full-season primary sponsor of Alex Palou's No. 10 Ganassi Honda in 2027.
Williams ran a one-off chrome livery with Atlassian in Las Vegas; Carlos Sainz brought it home eighth.
